001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CurrentBatteryV2Response;
007
008/**
009 * Battery snapshot the Tandem Mobi writes once an hour, at a fixed minute that drifts slowly and
010 * differs between pumps (it is not aligned to the clock hour). Not seen on the t:slim X2.
011 *
012 * The class name is provisional: opcode 271 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
013 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
014 *
015 * @see CurrentBatteryV2Response
016 */
017@HistoryLogProps(
018    opCode = 271,
019    displayName = "Battery Hourly"
020)
021public class BatteryHourlyHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
022
023    private int currentBatteryIbc;
024    private int unknown12;
025    private int lipoMv;
026    private int unknown16;
027    private int unknown18;
028    private int unknown20;
029    private int unknown22;
030    private int unknown24;
031
032    public BatteryHourlyHistoryLog() {}
033    public BatteryHourlyHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown12, int lipoMv, int unknown16, int unknown18, int unknown20, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
034        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
035        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentBatteryIbc, unknown12, lipoMv, unknown16, unknown18, unknown20, unknown22, unknown24);
036        this.currentBatteryIbc = currentBatteryIbc;
037        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
038        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
039        this.unknown16 = unknown16;
040        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
041        this.unknown20 = unknown20;
042        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
043        this.unknown24 = unknown24;
044    }
045
046    public int typeId() {
047        return 271;
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * <table border="1">
052     * <caption>Parsed fields for BatteryHourlyHistoryLog:</caption>
053     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryIbc</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>unknown16</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>unknown20</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>unknown24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
061     * </table>
062     */
063    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
064        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
065        this.cargo = raw;
066        parseBase(raw);
067        this.currentBatteryIbc = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
068        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
069        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
070        this.unknown16 = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
071        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
072        this.unknown20 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
073        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
074        this.unknown24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
075    }
076
077    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown12, int lipoMv, int unknown16, int unknown18, int unknown20, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
078        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
079            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(271, 0),
080            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
081            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
082            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBatteryIbc),
083            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
084            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoMv),
085            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown16),
086            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown18),
087            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown20),
088            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown22),
089            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown24)));
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryIbc()} read within 15 minutes in
094     * 319 of 320 checked records (two pumps): the pump-displayed battery percentage.
095     *
096     * @return battery percent, 0-100
097     */
098    public int getCurrentBatteryIbc() {
099        return currentBatteryIbc;
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * Not a constant. Usually 0x0128. Bit 0x0004 was set in 76 of 77 records at 30% or lower and
104     * in 1 record above that; the high byte was 0 or 2 only at 100%.
105     *
106     * @return raw uint16 at offset 12
107     */
108    public int getUnknown12() {
109        return unknown12;
110    }
111
112    /**
113     * Within 10 mV of {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown3()} read in the same minutes in
114     * 289 of 320 checked records, and close to {@link DailyBasalHistoryLog#getLipoMv()}.
115     *
116     * @return battery voltage in millivolts
117     */
118    public int getLipoMv() {
119        return lipoMv;
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * Signed. 0 in most records and -5 to -10 in some. Positive in 4 of 750 records; the one of
124     * those with live battery traffic was written while charging (+209, when
125     * {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown4()} read 207).
126     *
127     * @return raw int16 at offset 16
128     */
129    public int getUnknown16() {
130        return unknown16;
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * Tracks {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown2()}; 100 * unknown18 / unknown20 is within
135     * 1 of {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryAbc()} in 319 of 320 checked records
136     * (2 in the other).
137     *
138     * @return raw uint16 at offset 18
139     */
140    public int getUnknown18() {
141        return unknown18;
142    }
143
144    /**
145     * Tracks {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown1()} (about 143-159).
146     *
147     * @return raw uint16 at offset 20
148     */
149    public int getUnknown20() {
150        return unknown20;
151    }
152
153    /**
154     * Same kind of value as {@link #getUnknown18()}, within 3 of it.
155     *
156     * @return raw uint16 at offset 22
157     */
158    public int getUnknown22() {
159        return unknown22;
160    }
161
162    /**
163     * Same kind of value as {@link #getUnknown20()}.
164     *
165     * @return raw uint16 at offset 24
166     */
167    public int getUnknown24() {
168        return unknown24;
169    }
170}
